title: ElderAccessContextV1
description: The caller's authorization scope for one elder, returned by GET /api/v1/elders/{elder_id}/access-context. Document 10 section 5 forbids treating this as a durable grant: it is a UI hint only, and every high-risk command re-authorizes server-side.

purpose.description: Purpose this access context was evaluated for.

allowed_actions.description: Actions the caller may perform on this elder, as granted by the authorizing relationship or assignment. An empty array means no action is permitted.

source_type.description: Which kind of record granted access. Null when access was denied.

source_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the authorizing record. Must not disclose the identity of other actors or elders.

expires_at.description: When the authorizing record stops being valid, or null when it has no scheduled end. Clients must re-fetch rather than cache past this point.
